_doc: Budgets for python -m evals.resources --check evals/budget.json --profile <name>. Each 'max' maps a metric the run prints to the most it may be.

laptop._doc: Targets on the machine jharokha runs on: i5-8365U, 4 cores, 8 GB RAM. Checked by hand on that laptop, never in CI. Wall times count here.

ci._doc: Gated on every push on windows-latest. Memory and CPU time only: wall time on a shared runner is noise. Each value is a measured windows-latest baseline plus a margin (memory +25%, CPU time +50%, idle +1 point); until the first CI run replaces them, they are the laptop's numbers with that margin.
